header.running_head: Undertaking Journeys in Search of knowledge

blocks.text: Allaah shall conceal his faults on the Day of Qiyaamah. He therefore travelled all the way to Egypt to ask the Sahabi (RA) about the Hadith. The other Sahabi (RA) confirmed saying, "Yes, I have heard Rasulullaah ﷺ say that when a Muslim conceals the faults of his fellow Muslim brother in this world, Allaah shall conceal his faults on the Day of Qiyaamah." The first Sahabi (RA) then said, "I too have heard this Hadith from Rasulullaah ﷺ." [^1]
Hadhrat Abu Ayyoob Ansaari (RA) Travels to Egypt to Hear a Hadith from Hadhrat Uqba bin Aamir (RA)

Hadhrat Ibn Jurayj narrates that Hadhrat Abu Ayyoob Ansaari (RA) travelled all the way to Egypt to see Hadhrat Uqba bin Aamir (RA). When he arrived there, he said, "I wish to ask you about a Hadith that besides you and I, no other companion of Rasulullaah ﷺ survives who had heard it. What did you hear Rasulullaah ﷺ say about concealing the faults of a Muslim?" Hadhrat Uqba (RA) replied, "I have heard Rasulullaah ﷺ say, 'Whoever conceals the fault of a Mu'min in this world, Allaah shall conceal his faults on the Day of Qiyaamah.'" Hadhrat Abu Ayyoob (RA) then returned to Madinah and had already narrated the Hadith to others before even alighting from his conveyance. [^2]
Hadhrat Uqba bin Aamir (RA) Travels to see Hadhrat Maslama bin Mukhallad (RA) and another Sahabi (RA) Travels to see Hadhrat Fudhaala bin Ubayd (RA)

Hadhrat Makhool narrates that when Hadhrat Uqba bin Aamir (RA) went to see Hadhrat Maslama bin Mukhallad (RA), an argument ensued between the usher and Hadhrat Uqba (RA). Hearing the voice of Hadhrat Uqba (RA), Hadhrat Maslama (RA) permitted him entry. (When he entered) Hadhrat Uqba (RA) said, "I have not come merely to visit you, but have come for an urgent need. Do you remember the day when Rasulullaah ﷺ said, 'If a person conceals a sin that he knows his brother committed, Allaah will conceal his sins on the Day of Qiyaamah'?" When Hadhrat Maslama (RA) confirmed that he did remember, Hadhrat Uqba (RA) said, "That is why I have come." [^3]
Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Buraydah narrates that a Sahabi (RA) once travelled all the way to Egypt to see Hadhrat Fudhala bin Ubayd (RA) about a Hadith. [^4]
